mostWorthwhile.text: Creating different songs was most worthwhile: it distinguished inherited changes from learned traditions in separated bird populations.

leastWorthwhile.text: Creating far-ranging birds was the least clear passage; the result did not explain how mountains produced them.

surprise.text: Birds and mountains produced far-ranging birds rather than the separated populations I expected.
